title: Recording: Tragedy by Wings | 1973
content:
Studio Two, EMI Studios, London
Producer: Paul McCartney
Engineer: Alan Parsons

Wings continued recording their cover version of Thomas Wayne Perkins’ 1959 hit ‘Tragedy’ on 23 January 1973.

They had recorded the backing track on 13 March 1972. ‘Tragedy’ was originally a 1959 hit for Thomas Wayne and the DeLons.

On this day Wings added two tracks of lead vocals, two of backing vocals, and a piano part. ‘Tragedy’ was completed on 28 January.

Page last updated: 27 November 2025
